full.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen of a liver. The organ appears enlarged and congested, with a smooth, tense capsule and a pale, slightly mottled reddish-brown coloration. These macroscopic findings are characteristic of acute or chronic passive congestion of the liver, often associated with right-sided heart failure. The glossy sheen on the surface reflects the tense and stretched Glisson's capsule.

random.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of a liver viewed from its surface. The liver capsule appears tense, smooth, and distended with a slightly pale or reddish-brown coloration. This appearance can be seen in conditions causing hepatomegaly, such as passive congestion or acute hepatitis. The lobes are clearly visible, showing rounded borders characteristic of organ enlargement.
